Enhanced customer due diligence

Enhanced customer due diligence (ECDD) means applying extra measures when the money laundering or terrorism financing risk of a customer is high.

When you must apply ECDD

You must apply enhanced customer due diligence in each of these situations:

  • you assess the customer's ML/TF risk as high
  • the customer or a beneficial owner is a foreign politically exposed person
    • this includes a person acting on behalf of the customer
  • the customer is physically present in, or formed in, a high-risk jurisdiction subject to a FATF call for action
  • you gave a suspicious matter report and decided to continue the business relationship

Measures you can take

Measures include establishing the source of wealth and source of funds, obtaining senior manager approval, and increasing monitoring.

TriggerMinimum measure
Foreign PEPSource of wealth and source of funds

Examples

Example: overseas minister opens an account

A customer tells you they are a serving minister in a foreign government. They are a foreign PEP, so enhanced CDD applies before you provide the service.
